articles.description: The 29-year-old catcher passed on pursuing a long-term deal in free agency and will become the Twins’ highest-paid player next season.
articles.title: Ryan Jeffers accepts $23.15 million qualifying offer, will return to Twins in 2027

articles.description: The Twins want to re-sign their free-agent catcher and have met with his agent, Scott Boras. If Jeffers signs elsewhere, Minnesota will receive a compensatory draft pick.
articles.title: Ryan Jeffers plans to decline Twins’ $23.15 million qualifying offer, seek long-term deal

articles.description: Experimental restrictions on outfield positioning are producing more offense in the Arizona Fall League, and the Twins have the athletic outfielders who could benefit if the rule reaches the majors.
articles.title: MLB is testing a radical new outfield rule. Could the Twins benefit?
